entities.name: LLM
entities.how_described: 本集反复讨论 LLM 不是万能锤子：需要确定性（同样输入同样输出）或精确概率的场景 LLM 会失败，续约预测这类任务用传统方法反而更好；同时团队也在不断判断六个月后哪些问题会被 LLM 解决并自动化。

evidence.quote: Now he applies that same research mindset to production AI, where his team has to decide when to use an LLM, when traditional machine learning is actually better, and how to evaluate systems operating across millions of real-world interactions.
